items.title: Julius Handy Interview, 1973-05-09
items.q: And, uh, she and, uh, Marguerite Booth, she's in Oakland, California now.

ctx.x: it was amusing, you know, just to come up in the musical family. Of course. That's quite prevalent. Now, where I used to get my kicks showing up, when I began to learn my banjo a little more, Jeanette Kimbrell, she was a Jeanette Seliborne, but Jeanette Kimbrell, they had a movie picture show. We used to call it movie picture show, not a theater. We used to call it movie picture show. And, uh, Jeanette used to play in between the pitches. It was, it was a silent pitch.
